_note: The six branch-owned forms that replaced the homepage JotForms on 22 October 2026. Edit this file and run tools/forms/build-forms.py — never edit a generated page. Every form posts q.quote to the Service Questionnaire backend (apps-script/Quotes.gs) and the client gets a reference back. Deliberately NOT collected anywhere here: national ID or driver's permit numbers, policy card numbers, bank or card details, and any health declaration. Those are taken by a person, on the call or on the signed form.
